description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320236 (23/0615)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, land extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land settlement and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
